bio: Roddin knew that if he kept digging, he'd find something amazing. And that he did. An ever-shifting, endless cave – touch the Memorium Gem at its entrance, and everything begins anew. New paths, new treasures, new enemies. And if Roddin perishes within, he simply awakens at the entrance. It's certainly strange, but Roddin's not questioning an infinite treasure source.
